period_note: CONSOLIDATED (Group) basis, matching this bank's main Q4/annual series (see sources.json reporting_basis). Source: Southeast Bank's own BSEC-mandated 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' disclosure table, embedded in its annual report (a corporate-governance disclosure most banks answer with a checkbox, but which Southeast Bank answers with an actual Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 balance-sheet-and-income-statement table for that report's own year, plus a comparative column for the prior year). Balance-sheet line items are the 1 January to 30 September 2015 period-end snapshot (basis reported). Income-statement line items and EPS are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY 2015 ("1 January to 30 September 2015" exactly as the table's own column header states), not discrete-quarter figures -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, basis reported, same convention as CITYBANK. Balance-sheet identity (Total assets = Total liabilities + Total equity) holds to within a consistent ~BDT 8-11m gap (~0.002-0.004% of total assets), most plausibly a small Non-controlling-interest balance not broken out as its own row in this vintage of the table -- see the 2021-2025 vintage, which adds an explicit NCI row and closes this same gap almost exactly. Cumulative net profit after tax increases monotonically Q1->Q2->Q3 within 2015 (validated; no violation). This is the EARLIEST year this disclosure table appears in any Southeast Bank annual report in this archive (a full-text search of every report FY2011-FY2025 confirms the table -- titled 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' -- is present FY2016-FY2025 but genuinely absent FY2011-FY2015; the FY2014 report's own 'Report of the Audit Committee' section, checked in full, is pure narrative with no data table). FY2015 itself has NO own-year report carrying this table, so these figures are taken from the FY2016 report's comparative column -- the same sourcing pattern already used for this bank's FY2011-2013/2015 annual data. No independent second source exists for FY2015 interim figures (there is no earlier report to cross-check against).
